hypothesis: A single lightweight Gyro-only learnable rFFT branch focused on 0-12 Hz captures stable low-frequency and 3-7 Hz structure not fully used by V8-GN.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Retain only if BA improves by 0.01-0.015, AUROC by at least 0.015, Macro-F1 does not decline, DD recall does not materially decline, about 10/15 seed-averaged matched splits improve, and seed stability is preserved.
